summary: Richmond County list entry GA404 named walton; the list is the only source found, and no source describes the site now.

evidence.supports: A separate Walton Lookout Tower is listed in Dooly County at 32.06045, -83.66600

notes_for_editor: Single source. The list entry is the only record found for a Richmond County walton. NHLR's Georgia list has no Walton entry. A search for Richmond County forestry tower history returned only Augusta's Big Steve bell tower, a downtown fire-alarm tower; it is not a forestry lookout, is not this site, and is not used. The list's 353 has no unit stated; the brief's 107.6 m matches 353 feet. The Dooly County Walton Lookout Tower (GA059) is a different tower and is not covered here. The story is at the 120-word floor because the list is the only source found.
